title: Opening a call and setting the agenda

grammar.title: Present simple vs present continuous per gli aggiornamenti di stato
grammar.explanation: In apertura di call dai quasi sempre un aggiornamento di stato, e servono due presenti diversi. Il present simple (we run, it calls, the job fails) descrive routine, processi stabili e fatti sempre veri: cosa fa un servizio, ogni quanto gira un batch, chi è responsabile di cosa. Parole tipiche: every day, usually, twice a week, always. Il present continuous (we're testing, I'm looking into it) descrive ciò che succede adesso o in questo periodo: lavoro in corso, attività temporanee. Parole tipiche: right now, currently, this week, at the moment. Nella stessa frase li usi spesso insieme: il simple dà il contesto ('The reconciliation runs every morning'), il continuous lo stato attuale ('This week we're moving it to the new cluster'). Attenzione ai verbi di stato (know, need, understand, depend, mean): restano al simple anche quando parli di adesso. Si dice 'I understand', non 'I'm understanding'.

examples.en: The reconciliation job runs every morning at six.
This week we're migrating the batch to the new cluster.
I'm looking into the error right now.
The onboarding service calls the KYC provider for every new client.
Currently we're testing the fix in staging.
We need the partner bank's file by nine.

grammar.italianTrap: In italiano il presente copre tutto ('ci lavoro adesso'), quindi viene spontaneo dire 'I work on it now' o 'Now we test the fix'. Per ciò che accade adesso serve il continuous: 'I'm working on it now', 'We're testing the fix right now'. E 'attualmente' si dice 'currently', non 'actually' (che significa 'in realtà').

phrases.en: Let's give it a couple of minutes for the others to join.
phrases.it: Aspettiamo un paio di minuti che si colleghino gli altri.

phrases.en: The purpose of today's call is to review the reconciliation issue.
phrases.it: Lo scopo della call di oggi è rivedere il problema di riconciliazione.

phrases.en: There are three points I'd like to cover today.
phrases.it: Ci sono tre punti che vorrei trattare oggi.

phrases.en: First, a quick status update. Then, next steps.
phrases.it: Prima un breve aggiornamento, poi i prossimi passi.

phrases.en: Let's start with where we are on the migration.
phrases.it: Partiamo da dove siamo con la migrazione.

phrases.en: Before we start, does anyone want to add anything to the agenda?
phrases.it: Prima di iniziare, qualcuno vuole aggiungere qualcosa all'agenda?

phrases.en: I'll share my screen in a second.
phrases.it: Condivido lo schermo tra un attimo.

phrases.en: We've got about thirty minutes, so let's keep it focused.
phrases.it: Abbiamo circa trenta minuti, restiamo sul punto.

quiz.q: You are opening a call with the partner bank. Which first line sounds most natural?
options: Hello, we can begin the meeting now with everybody.
Good morning to all the persons connected.
I welcome you in this call.
quiz.why: 'Thanks everyone for joining' è la formula standard, breve e cordiale. Le altre sono calchi dall'italiano o suonano rigide.

quiz.q: 'The reconciliation job ___ every morning at six.'
quiz.why: Routine ripetuta ('every morning'): present simple, con -s alla terza persona.

quiz.q: 'Right now we ___ the logs with the vendor.'
quiz.why: 'Right now' indica un'azione in corso: present continuous.

quiz.q: 'I ___ what you mean, but the file is still missing.'
quiz.why: 'Understand' è un verbo di stato: resta al present simple anche quando parli di adesso.

options: There are two points I'd like to cover.
Sorry, I'm a bit late, the previous meeting ran over.
quiz.why: Annuncia i punti da trattare: è la frase tipica per fissare l'agenda.

quiz.q: 'This week the team ___ the new signature provider into the onboarding flow.'
quiz.why: 'This week' indica un lavoro temporaneo in corso: present continuous.

quiz.q: The PM asks: 'What's the status of the migration?' Which answer is correct?
options: Now we migrating it, it's nearly finished.
quiz.why: Azione in corso: 'be' + verbo in -ing. Le altre mancano di un pezzo o usano il simple.

gapfill.text: At the moment we ___ testing the fix in staging.
The batch usually ___ at two in the morning.

reorder.answer: There are three points I'd like to cover.
We're currently migrating the batch to the new cluster.

fluency.prompt: You are hosting the weekly call with the partner bank. Thank them, state the purpose and list two agenda points. 30 seconds.
fluency.model: Thanks everyone for joining. The purpose of today's call is to review last week's reconciliation results. There are two points I'd like to cover: first the missing transactions, then the plan for next week.

fluency.prompt: Someone from the vendor joins five minutes late. Welcome them and say what you are discussing right now. 20 seconds.
fluency.model: Hi, welcome. We've just started. Right now we're going through the status of the integration.

fluency.prompt: Your internal team asks for a status update on the order routing service. Say what the service does every day and what you are doing this week. 45 seconds.
fluency.model: The order routing service sends orders to the fund platform every day at noon. It usually processes about two hundred orders. This week we're adding a retry mechanism, and at the moment we're testing it in staging.
